description: Pinned upstream data sources for KanjiForge MVP (T0.1 block)
notes: All required T0.1 sources fetched and verified. Tatoeba (~900 MB combined CSV files) and JmdictFurigana included. License hashes record sha256 of actual fetched upstream license files (orchestrator caught and corrected two cases where the implementing agent had hashed 404 error pages for kanjivg and jmdictfurigana, and a third where tatoeba's license fetch returned a generic site error page instead of the terms-of-use content -- all three replaced with real license text on 2026-07-25). JmdictFurigana license recorded as "MIT" per the LICENSE file in https://github.com/Doublevil/JmdictFurigana (raw); note that README.md claims "same licence as JMDict (CC BY-SA)" -- we use the explicit LICENSE file as authoritative for the published artifact. EDRDG license text from https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html .

kanjivg.name: KanjiVG
kanjivg.attribution: Stroke data derived from KanjiVG by Ulrich Apel, CC BY-SA 3.0. Paths normalized and re-encoded.

tatoeba.name: Tatoeba (sentences + links + WWWJDIC indices)
tatoeba.provenance: Includes Tanaka Corpus JA-EN example sentences
tatoeba.note: Large multi-file corpus (~930 MB combined); use wwwjdic indices for JMdict sense linking

jmdictfurigana.name: JmdictFurigana (per-character furigana alignments)
jmdictfurigana.provenance: Maps JMdict (kanji-writing, kana-reading) pairs to furigana alignments
jmdictfurigana.note: Solves rendaku/jukujikun/ateji alignment; critical for reading support

jlpt-kanji-data.name: JLPT Kanji Data (davidluzgouveia)
jlpt-kanji-data.provenance: Derived from Jonathan Waller's JLPT Resources (tanos.co.uk), CC BY
jlpt-kanji-data.note: Actual commit SHA fetched from GitHub API; prior entry used fabricated hash

jlpt-vocab-yomitan.name: JLPT Vocabulary (yomitan)
jlpt-vocab-yomitan.provenance: Derived from Jonathan Waller's JLPT Resources (tanos.co.uk), CC BY
jlpt-vocab-yomitan.note: Fetched actual release 2025.08.01.0 (confirmed latest); recorded real checksums
